description.en: Original native-copper-inspired dendritic crystal aggregate with unequal continuous flattened branching sheets and blunt irregular flared terminal growth, deliberate coalescent junctions and restrained metal response. Gray shape carries identity; not an old sponge/tree recolor or industrial wire. Nominal15cm span, palette and flat display contact at lower crystal surface are artistic, no measured mineral locality/specimen.
description.zh: 原创自然铜启发枝晶：不等粗连续扁平分枝片、钝不规则外展端部与有意共生融合接点，金属响应克制；灰色结构可识别，非旧海绵树枝换色或工业导线。名义15厘米、配色及下表面平放接触属美术选择，不作实测矿点标本。
